request: I run a small tailoring shop in Kumasi and I want to keep my orders in order. I need to save each customer with their name, phone number and their measurements: chest, waist, hip and length, all in inches. For a customer I take orders, and each order has the garment, the date it is due, the price and the deposit the customer has paid, in cedis. The deposit can never be more than the price. I want to see all the orders for one customer and look at a single order. I also want to see every order that is due on or before a date I choose, so I know what to finish first. When a customer picks up their clothes I mark the order as collected, and collected orders should no longer show in that due list.
summary:
Each order now has to name the tailor who will sew it, and all my checks pass.

**What changed:** When you add an order, you must give the tailor's name. If it's missing, empty or just blank spaces, the order is turned away. The name is saved with the order and shows whenever you look at it.

**Orders you already had:** Any order saved before this change has no tailor, so it now shows "Not recorded". You can't add the real name to those orders yet, because changing orders isn't possible.

**Everything else is the same:**
- You save customers with their measurements in inches and add orders priced in cedis.
- You can see all of one customer's orders or look at a single order.
- You can list the uncollected orders due on or before a date, soonest first.
- You can mark an order as collected.

**Still turned away:**
- A deposit bigger than the price
- A negative price or deposit
- Measurements of zero or less
- Missing details
- A date that isn't a real date
- Marking the same order collected twice

You still look up customers and orders by the number each one gets when you save it.
messages: Each order must also say which tailor will sew it, by name. Refuse an order without it.
